source: Live Financial Ecosystem — Official Event Rulebook, FINAL_RULES.docx

accounts.startingCapital.note: Exact figure set by organisers from the price scale of the stock universe; must be equal across teams.

qualification.tieBreak.note: The rulebook's recommended order, kept: highest Phase 1 peak value, then fewer trades, then a coin toss.

fund.seedCapital.note: Organiser decision: when the funds are formed, both qualifying teams' whole portfolios (cash and shares) go into their fund, and each team gets units for what it brought at the launch NAV. seedCapital (extra money from the organisers) stays 0.

fees.managementFeePercent.note: Organiser decision: each fund chooses its own management fee from 1% to 2% on its Fund desk; 1.5% applies until it chooses, and it is fixed once investors have put money in.

fees.managementFeeBasis.note: FINAL_RULES.docx Section 12: charged on the fund's average AUM across each settlement period (each gap between consecutive checkpoints).

event.timeline.note: The organisers run the event step by step: each step lasts until an organiser moves to the next one (Control room). The rulebook's 5-hour timeline is only a rough plan for the people running the venue.

leaderboard.visibleToParticipants.note: Organiser decision: players see the standings (rank, portfolio value, % return) during Phase 1 only; they are hidden in Phase 2. Organisers always see them. Set this to true to show them to players throughout.

market.symbolCount.note: FINAL_RULES.docx: approximately 150 companies across 15 sectors, matching the organisers' final data (150).

market.maxSingleStockPercent.note: FINAL_RULES.docx Section 14: no buy may put more than 25% of the total portfolio (cash, shares and fund units) in one stock, checked only when the buy is placed.

teams.investorTeamSize.note: Teams of 3, as the rulebook says. A team is one account with one portfolio. The person who registers the team is its leader and signs in with the team's own login; the other two join with the team code and get their own logins that see the team's dashboard (Section 18: nobody shares a password). Only one login per team may trade or move money: the leader, unless the leader or an organiser hands it to a teammate. Set this to 1 to turn joining off.

teams.fundTeamSize.note: With one account per team, a fund is 2 merged accounts (whatever headcount FINAL_RULES.docx's own "6 members" describes standing behind those 2 accounts on the ground).

teams.fundManagerSeats.note: 20 fund manager accounts (the Top 20 by Phase 1 value), mirror-paired into 10 funds of 2 accounts each.

event.participants.note: The rulebook text says 600-650 (and 700-750 in places); the organisers later confirmed about 1,000 people in about 350 teams of 3. 20 teams still become fund managers; everyone else invests. Shown for reference only; nothing is sized from it.

prizes.prize4.riskAdjustedReturn.note: Prize 4 weights are a starting point; organisers may tune.

prizes.prize4.diversificationCapHoldings.note: Rulebook says diversification scores 'up to a sensible point' without a number.

prizes.prize3.rubric.note: Organiser decision: all four prizes are decided by the organisers in person. The platform shows standings (all teams, investors, funds) and the strategy logs; it does not score prizes.

technical.minimumDeviceRequirements.note: Publish at least a day before the event.
